document.title: Reviews cite the PR comments that asked for the code
document.summary: The skill now cites a review comment on the group whose code that comment asked for. The eval producer stops loading personal agent rules and keeps its session id.
document.why: [Reviews sometimes leave PR comments out of their sources](source:s1), so the eval check fails with `missing source kinds: pr-comment` on three cases.

sources.title: [Compre] Skill: reviews intermittently omit PR-comment sources
sources.gist: 8 of 48 main eval runs failed with missing pr-comment sources on shadcn-10453, cobra-2356 and caddy-8015.

sources.label: PR #180
sources.title: Reviews cite the PR comments that asked for the code
sources.gist: Debriefs blame the circular emit rule; v1 passes 30/30 locally; the harness drops personal rules.

lookFor: [The issue is done when reviews cite PR comments across repeated graded eval runs](source:s1). [The PR measures 30 local runs without graders and 2 graded runs per case](source:s2); the graded suite on `main` runs only after merge.

groups.title: Cite the comment that asked for the code
groups.why: [The debriefed runs left comments out because the PR body restated the outcome](source:s2), and the old rule emitted a `pr-comment` only when the prose already cited it.
groups.summary: The PR comments rule in The why and the Attention rule both now cite a review comment on the group that holds the code it asked for; `.agents/skills` repeats the same edit.

attention.note: Every comment that asked for code at head now gets a `pr-comment` source, even when the PR body repeats the outcome. Reviews carry more quotes, and a small nit that changed code also qualifies. Bots, thanks, and approvals ask for no code, so they stay out.

fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md: The edited source of the skill.
fileNotes..agents/skills/comprehende/SKILL.md: Copy written by `pnpm sync:skill`; same two lines.

groups.title: Eval producer matches CI and keeps its session
groups.why: [Local runs loaded personal agent rules that CI does not have](source:s2), and a failing run needs its session id to be exported and debriefed.
groups.summary: `runMuseCodeAgent` passes `--no-foreign-personal-context` to `muse exec` and returns the parsed `sessionId` on a finished run.

notes.body: CI has no personal rules, so this flag changes only local `--cli-login` runs.

commits.subject: Skill: a review comment that asked for code at head is cited on its group
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Reviews sometimes cited only the PR body, which restates what review comments asked for, and left every pr-comment out (#178).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Eval: keep personal rules out of the producer and save its session id
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
A local --cli-login run loaded the developer's personal agent rules, so local runs did not match CI. The session id lets a failing run be exported and debriefed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
